definitions.gloss: to call in, to invite in
definitions.explanation: To summon someone to come inside or to a specific place.
To bring in customers, visitors, or attention through active promotion or appeal.

examples.japanese: ⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{呼|よ}び{込|こ}んだ。
examples.english: I called my friend into the room.
The store clerk is calling customers into the shop.

examples.japanese: ⟦{医者|いしゃ}→医者：02847_isha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{患者|かんじゃ}→患者：00170_kanja⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{診察室|しんさつしつ}→診察室：15666_shinsatsushitsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{呼|よ}び{込|こ}んだ。
examples.english: The doctor called the next patient into the examination room.

examples.japanese: ⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}り{出|だ}した→降り出す：03004_furidasu⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{外|そと}→外：00671_soto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{遊|あそ}んで→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦{子|こ}どもたち→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{呼|よ}び{込|こ}んだ。
examples.english: It started to rain, so I called the children who were playing outside into the house.

examples.japanese: ⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{呼|よ}び{込|こ}む。
⟦イベント→イベント：09594_ibento⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{多|おお}く→多く：18752_ooku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{観光客|かんこうきゃく}→観光客：03022_kankoukyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{呼|よ}び{込|こ}む。
examples.english: To attract many tourists with an event.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦サービス→サービス：01531_saabisu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{若|わか}い→若い：00823_wakai⟧⟦{世代|せだい}→世代：05102_sedai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{呼|よ}び{込|こ}みたい。
examples.english: We want to attract the younger generation with new services.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{生|い}かした→生かす：10422_ikasu⟧⟦{観光|かんこう}→観光：00173_kankou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{呼|よ}び{込|こ}もう⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: This area is trying to attract people through nature-based tourism.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{商業施設|しょうぎょうしせつ}→商業施設：noentry⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できて→できる：00557_dekiru⟧、⟦{周辺|しゅうへん}→周辺：09896_shuuhen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{呼|よ}び{込|こ}んで⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: A new commercial facility opened in front of the station, attracting customers to the surrounding shops as well.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive). No pair verb.

COMPOUND STRUCTURE: ⟦{呼|よ}ぶ→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧ (to call) + ⟦{込|こ}む→込む：00719_komu⟧ (into). The ～⟦{込|こ}む→込む：00719_komu⟧ suffix adds the meaning of drawing inward.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{呼|よ}び{込|こ}む (attract customers)
- ⟦{観光客|かんこうきゃく}→観光客：03022_kankoukyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{呼|よ}び{込|こ}む (attract tourists)
- ⟦{投資|とうし}→投資：04711_toushi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{呼|よ}び{込|こ}む (attract investment)

Usage note: Often used in business contexts for marketing and sales activities. The related noun {呼|よ}び{込|こ}み refers to the act of soliciting customers on the street.
